title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator readiness — Batch 21: Djibouti

administrative_geography.separate_city_status: Djibouti City has a distinct statutory status and is not a sixth decentralised region.

key_findings: Official government material confirms five decentralised regional collectivities and a separately governed Djibouti City.
The Ministry of Agriculture identifies livestock as a predominant rural activity, with approximately 90 percent nomadic; this is a livelihood-system context, not a quantified domestic herd dataset.
Dikhil is identified by the government as a region with market-gardening activity.

A historical 2019/2020 vegetable production aggregate of 9,896 tonnes is cited by a 2024 French Treasury note; it is not crop-specific and has no matching area/yield breakdown in the evidence reviewed.
FAOSTAT crop and livestock annual series are available as a dataset route through 2024, but Djibouti observations, source flags and estimation status still require extraction.
FEWS NET provides downloadable weekly staple-food market-price data, but the actual records must be inspected and cannot be assumed to be farmgate prices.
Current crop-specific regional yields, farmgate prices, seed/input prices, irrigation and energy costs, labour and machinery rates, and enterprise budgets remain unverified.
safeguards: No active country profile or calculator formula was changed.
No missing yield, price or cost was imputed.
No merge or production deployment was performed.
next_step: Extract and validate FAOSTAT crop/livestock observations and FEWS NET weekly price records; obtain current region-specific farmgate prices and farmer-paid input/water/energy/labour costs before constructing enterprise budgets.
